questions.en: Which customers does {name} disclose, and what share of its revenue does each represent?
questions.zh: {name} 披露了哪些客户？每个客户占其收入的比例是多少？

questions.en: Which other companies' filings name {name} as a counterparty?
questions.zh: 哪些其他公司的申报文件将 {name} 列为交易对手？

questions.en: Does {name} disclose reliance on a sole or limited source, a contract manufacturer or a foundry?
questions.zh: {name} 是否披露依赖单一或有限来源、合同制造商或晶圆代工厂？

questions.en: What licensing or distribution relationships does {name} disclose?
questions.zh: {name} 披露了哪些许可或分销关系？

questions.en: Which filing is the evidence about {name} from, and is it fresh or stale?
questions.zh: 关于 {name} 的证据来自哪份申报文件？是最新的还是已过时？

questions.en: Has a later filing reasserted, restated or contradicted a share {name} disclosed?
questions.zh: 后续申报文件是否重申、重述或与 {name} 披露的比例相矛盾？

rule: Predeclared 2026-10-22 before any M2 leaf row exists. Issuers = per domain, the 5 issuer_ids of leaves_v1.json domain_of with the smallest sha256('gmi-rel-envelope-panel-v1:'+issuer_id) hex digest. Questions fixed below; every (issuer, question) cell is answered by the frozen rules of envelope.py and printed, never dropped.

ANSWERED_ANONYMOUS.en: Answered; the filing does not name the counterparty
ANSWERED_ANONYMOUS.zh: 已作答；申报文件未披露交易对手名称

ANSWERED_FACT.zh: 已根据所引申报文件作答

ANSWERED_NONE_FOUND.en: The filings we read disclose none
ANSWERED_NONE_FOUND.zh: 我们阅读的申报文件中未披露
